_comment: A ready reply from this server's own /api/geo/cems-forecast, recorded so the EU forecast provider can be exercised without a Copernicus token or a queued retrieval. The shape is what server/routes/cems-forecast.ts builds: zones scored against each cell's 1991-2020 flood frequency, with full provenance.
detail: GloFAS ensemble forecast scored against each cell's own 1991-2020 flood frequency.

provenance.sourceName: Copernicus GloFAS — ensemble river discharge forecast
provenance.licence: Copernicus Open Access (free reuse with attribution)
provenance.attribution: Copernicus Emergency Management Service — Global Flood Awareness System (GloFAS), via the ECMWF Data Store

coverage.detail: GloFAS models river discharge on a 0.05° grid, so it does not resolve small watercourses, surface-water flooding from rainfall, or drainage failure. 412 of 560 cells have no 1991-2020 record that supports a flood frequency fit — mostly cells that carry no river — and carry no verdict either way.
